zh-CN.title: 头像框库进一步精简
items: 配饰系列正式下架，仅保留具有明确视觉结构的取景器
取景器现已归入工艺限定，与剪纸和机械共同展示
正在使用旧配饰的用户会自动迁移到最接近的保留款式

en.title: The avatar frame library is now more focused
items: The accessory collection has been retired, leaving Viewfinder as its only structurally distinctive design
Viewfinder now sits in Crafted alongside Papercut and Mechanical
Existing accessory selections migrate automatically to the closest retained design
